about_the_game:
In Hook of Abyss, you take on the role of a daring sailor, navigating a heavily modified fishing vessel across seas consumed by an apocalyptic flood. Humanity survives only on scattered isles, and your mission is to venture into the deep, face mutated fish that threaten the fragile balance, and uncover the truth beneath the waters.

Armed with your fishing line as both weapon and lifeline, you must parry, evade, and strike back in tense encounters, exploiting every opening to hunt terrifying deep-sea monsters. Each victory rewards you with loot and upgrades, allowing you to strengthen your ship, unlock new abilities, and prepare for even deadlier foes that lurk in the abyss.

The game blends fast-paced, skill-based combat with the progression of a roguelite adventure. With procedurally generated seas, every expedition offers new challenges, rewards, and surprises, ensuring no two voyages are alike.

Whether you’re mastering precise timing in combat, choosing the right upgrades to survive, or pushing deeper into the unknown, Hook of Abyss delivers an intense experience where every cast of the line carries both risk and promise.

The abyss is calling—will you dare to cast your hook?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains some combat violence content.
